subject: Integrator success fee, trial credits, and lead handoff process
messages:
From: Jared Huang <jared@integratek.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@integratek.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership commercial ask — success fee + trial credits

Monica,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Integratek is excited to embed Redwood's embeddings into our partner analytics product. Before we move to a pilot, our commercial team needs clarity on two items so we can scope customer-facing offers: 1) a one-time success fee tied to first paid deployment (we usually budget a 8–12% success fee), and 2) a short-term trial credit package that we can offer to customers during onboarding.

High level ask: can Redwood commit to a success-fee model (flat percentage of first-year subscription) plus a $5k trial credit for the pilot customers? We also need a simple lead-handoff process — Integratek will qualify leads and register them with Redwood; how do you validate and protect registered leads?

Attaching our typical partner intake form for context.

Thanks,
Jared Huang
Head of Partnerships | Integratek
Attachment: Integratek_partner_intake.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jared Huang <jared@integratek.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial ask — success fee + trial credits

Jared —

Really glad to hear there’s momentum. Short answers up front: we can do a success fee + trial credits, but we need to lock the definitions and guardrails. Proposed structure:

- Success fee: 10% of first-year recurring revenue (paid as a one-time commission within 30 days of customer invoice).
- Trial credits: Redwood will provide up to $5,000 in platform credits per pilot customer, redeemable within 90 days; credits are not refundable and apply to hosted usage only.
- Lead registration: Integratek submits a lead form + timestamped proof (Intro email or HubSpot record). Registration window: 30 days prior to first invoice. We’ll require a unique customer domain and a short intake (I can share a template).

Next steps: looping in Camila (partner ops) for the lead protection flow and Karthik for commission accounting / tiering rules. If that structure sounds ok, Camila will propose a short MOU and I’ll share a draft term sheet.

Best,
Monica Patel
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jared Huang <jared@integratek.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial ask — success fee + trial credits

Jared / Monica —

Thanks — quick operational notes from Partner Ops:

- Lead registration form: please use this template (one-line intro email + company domain + expected ARR band). We will validate in HubSpot and issue a registration ID.
- Eligibility: trial credits limited to customers with no prior Redwood account; credits consumed only on hosted Redwood endpoints (we can discuss Private later).
- Clawback: if the customer churns or cancels within 60 days of first invoice, Redwood reserves the right to reclaim success fee on a pro rata basis.
- Reporting cadence: Integratek to provide a monthly leads summary during pilot; Redwood will share redemption reports weekly.

I’ve attached a short draft MOU and a spreadsheet for the credit schedule. Please review and mark up.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Partner Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MOU_integratek_v0.1.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)
Attachment: trial-credit-schedule.xlsx (XLSX, 22 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jared Huang <jared@integratek.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial ask — success fee + trial credits

Jared — quick note from commercial/tax: 10% of first-year ARR is fine, but a few practical items to confirm so we can automate payments:

- Define "first-year ARR" in the MOU (gross billings to the customer excluding taxes, credits, and any third-party passthroughs).
- Payment trigger: commission invoice from Integratek must include the registration ID and the customer invoice number; payments processed net 30 from Redwood invoice date.
- Tiering: if Integratek helps close > $500k ARR in the first 12 months across deals, we can increase success fee to 12% retroactively for that tranche.
- Tax & compliance: we need Integratek W-9/W-8 and a signing entity for payouts.

I’ll add these as redlines in the MOU and link to the payment workflow doc.

— Karthik
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jared Huang <jared@integratek.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership commercial ask — success fee + trial credits

Team / Jared —

This looks reasonable; small prioritization note from the GTM side: we want a short onboarding path so sales teams can close pilots quickly. Action items before signature:

1) Camila: finalize the registration form and add the HubSpot validation step (due EOD Mon 9/13).
2) Karthik: include the payment flow and W-9 checklist in the MOU redline (due Tue 9/14).
3) Monica: share the cleaned term sheet with Jared and Integratek legal (I’ll approve final after redlines).

Jared — once the four items above are done, I’m comfortable with the 10% base + $5k trial credit model. Let’s aim to have the MOU signed and the pilot kicked off by end of month.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
